title: Saggar Workshop (November)
source_quote: In this special form of raku, students will coat their bisqueware with clay before firing the ware in the kiln. The course consists of 2 sessions: A prep session on Monday, November 16, 6:30-8:30 PM; and the firing on Sunday, November 22, 11-3 PM.
